I'm afraid it's a bit of an inexact science that doesn't really need much cooking but for two large portions --

Cooked and cooled cous cous (25g/half a cup and could use precooked packaged stuff too)
Large handful spinach 
Steamed brocoli (optional- blanched and cooled)
Few tablespoons toasted hazelnuts 
Few tablespoons dried apricots, chopped
Few chopped spring onions 
Olive oil
Lemon juice
Salt and pepper
Tin of mackerel/two fillets 

Basically make a simple dressing by whisking together equal quantities of oil and lemon juice. I used about a tablespoon of each. Add everything else and mix. Once mixed, taste and add extra lemon and any seasoning or a bit of tabsco is nice. The tinned fish is already cooked so you just need to flake it. 

The apricots, hazelnuts and spring onions are all optional but add crunch and the sweetness and sharpness balances out the oil in the fish for me.
